{{Top|leg}}
'''Security specialists''' were [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]] with special training and knowledge in the area of personnel protection. They served in a similar capacity to [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] but were more long term and had generally more formalized training in close-quarter and hand-to-hand combat.
